disclaimer: Illustrative population model. These subscriber counts, activity levels, and API tasks are NOT observed provider usage, guidance, or financial forecasts.

reported_context.metric: Reported September 2026 annualized revenue run rate
reported_context.period: Annualized from September 2026; not actual FY revenue
reported_context.scope: OpenAI broad revenue, reporting perimeter may differ across reports
reported_context.note: Reuters October 8 report says near $50B, versus earlier near $70B under a different definition. Do not equate run rate to audited revenue or use it as a direct numerator for our serving-cost model.

reported_context.metric: Reported revenue, nine months to September 30 2026
reported_context.scope: Anthropic combined consumption and subscription revenue
reported_context.note: Approximate, rounded from $26.3B consumption plus $6.9B subscriptions; not monthly or annual reported revenue.

reported_context.metric: Reported compute and infrastructure expense, same nine months
reported_context.scope: Company compute INCLUDING customer serving and model development
reported_context.note: Includes development and research compute. NOT directly comparable to model-only serving expense, and not an additional expense to add to modeled GPU costs.

reported_context.metric: Alphabet Google Cloud revenue, third quarter 2026
reported_context.scope: Google Cloud segment across AI and non-AI products
reported_context.note: NOT Gemini-only revenue. Google does not report sufficiently separated Gemini App/AI Pro revenue and serving cost for an apples-to-apples comparison.

notes: The modeled macro estimates describe a hypothetical AI-serving operation, not real company cash spend or audited revenue.
User counts are entirely editable hypothetical inputs. Active users do not equal paying subscribers.
Monthly revenue is paid users × subscription price + free users × assumed ads/user + API task retail value × realization fraction.
Serving cost is the per-task research model multiplied by assumed monthly paid/free/API task counts.
Zero in additional business expense means not included, NOT that real companies spend zero on training, R&D, sales or finance.
Daily = monthly × 12 / 365.25, yearly = monthly × 12. These are normalized rates, not actual historical daily/monthly filings.

The tier_demo distributions are deliberately invented illustrations; they are NOT real provider subscriber counts or entitlement data. Higher-tier default usage rates are scenario choices, not reported limits.
